summary: IDEAYA Biosciences filed an 8-K reporting a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of 7,222,225 shares of common stock and pre-funded warrants to purchase 5,555,576 shares at $27.00 per share/$26.9999 per warrant, with proceeds netting ~$323.6M. The underwriters (J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, TD Securities, UBS, Cantor Fitzgerald) purchased at $25.38 per share and $25.3799 per warrant. A 60-day lock-up applies to directors/officers. This is a routine capital raise via an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. No change of control, restructuring, or M&A event is involved.
